dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: It's not looking too good... The hilichurls have been increasingly active recently, it's becoming quite a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: But there's not much I can do beyond warning the adventurers and travelers around here to watch their backs.

dialogues.speaker: Lorgar
dialogues.text: Here are some notes I jotted down, maybe you'll find them helpful. Take care now.
